create-policy: The five lifecycle policies give only the private non-bypass role row-scoped access derived from the deleted source or the inserted record. Catalog-only policy creation scans no history, under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-trigger: The record and entity lifecycle triggers are attached through catalog changes after the source table's gate exists; this migration executes no application DML or history backfill. Lock acquisition is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and each statement by 5s statement_timeout.
add-foreign-key: After the source lifecycle triggers are installed, the current-source foreign key changes from cascade to restrict as NOT VALID, without scanning live rows. Gated online validation follows; lock_timeout is 1s and statement_timeout is 5s.
